# `docker-build-check.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| allow_fork_prs | Allow fork PRs to run this workflow | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| build_args | Newline-separated build args (KEY=value per line) | `string` | `` | no |
| cache | Use the GitHub Actions layer cache | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| context | Build context directory | `string` | `.` | no |
| dockerfile | Path to the Dockerfile, relative to the repo root | `string` | `Dockerfile` | no |
| platform | Target platform. Defaults to linux/arm64 to match the cluster, which is what the fleet builds for. Paired with an arm64 runner this is a native build -- no QEMU, unlike a cross-build on an amd64 runner. | `string` | `linux/arm64` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array. ubuntu-24.04-arm is free for public repos and builds linux/arm64 natively. | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04-arm"]` | no |
| scan_image | Scan the built image for secrets | `boolean` | `true` | no |
| trufflehog_extra_args | Extra flags for the image scan. Do NOT pass --fail; the invocation below already sets it and trufflehog rejects a repeated flag. | `string` | `--only-verified` | no |
